elaine: quick async standup — kernel + batching + KV bench notes. what I did / blockers / today

elaine: TL;DR: merged microbatch scheduling fix, ran two small perf benches, saw KV hit-rate drop on long tails.

jon: nice. can you paste the bench numbers? :eyes: 

elaine: numbers: p50 12ms -> 11ms, p95 120ms -> 98ms after fix. tokens/s per GPU: 480 -> 510. KV hit-rate overall 84% -> 79% on tails (long seq workloads).

ben: hmm that tail drop was the prefetch expiry TTL change? I saw evictions spike in prometheus. link: http://grafana.redwood/local/d/kv-ops/evictions (posted)

elaine: yes, TTL lowered to 30s to free memory for the canary. might revert and add adaptive TTL. blocker: can't reproduce tail in local env — seems infra-dependent.

sophia: can you share a minimal repro config? I can try on onprem cluster later. also pinged you on the kernel backpressure PR.

elaine: PR #5422 — fixes scheduling starvation + microbatcher jitter. CI flaked on macos jobs, investigating.

jon: today: 1) iterate on adaptive TTL + small perf sweep, 2) follow up on PR fixes, 3) pair with sophia for repro.

ben: FYI i'm running a longer 6hr benchmark overnight with KV warmup on dedicated dev pool — will post results in morning :coffee:

sophia: i'll try repro at 09:30 PT. might need a config tweak: PREFETCH_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.65. ping me if you want to pair.
